faq_heading: Maple Ridge condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Maple Ridge condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 157 of 246, or 64%. A further 85 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: $463,500 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $390,000 and $532,925.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: West Central, at $445,950 across 98 sales at $534 a square foot, median year built 2015. The highest of the 3 lowest was East Central at $482,500.

faq.q: How fast do Maple Ridge condos sell?
faq.a: 28 days at the median, closing at 97.5% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Maple Ridge

In West Central the median condo sold for $445,950 across 98 sales, $154,050 under $600,000. Across Maple Ridge the median condo took 28 days to sell and closed at 97.5% of the last list price, with 6% of the 246 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
